biotools.summary: TriTan is a tool for integrative analysis of single-cell multiomics data, implementing a highly efficient factorization algorithm to cluster cells, identify signature features, and predict cell-type-specific regulatory networks. It utilizes non-negative matrix factorization to process transcriptomes, epigenomes, and proteomes simultaneously.
